issues.label: Kaski chemical fertilizer rates
issues.evidence: Both Kaski schedules refer to the Government of Nepal rate. The signed procedure defines national import, depot and local outlet tiers. Pokhara’s workbook supplies a city-specific farmer outlet rate.
issues.next: Obtain an applicable government or district order specifying the price tier, product and effective period for the Kaski entry.

issues.next: Find an issuer decision specifying the date.
